name: Chofu Seisakusho Co., Ltd.
summary: Chofu Seisakusho Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells residential appliances under the Chofu and Sunpot brands in Japan. The company offers water heaters comprising oil water heaters, oil bath boilers, gas water heaters, gas bath boilers, electric water heaters, and EcoCute heat pump water heaters; air conditioning equipment consisting of oil stoves, gas stoves, hot water heating systems, geothermal heat pumps, and snow melting systems; and system equipment, such as system bathrooms, artificial marble bathtubs, and system kitchens.
